idea-plugin.name: HMRC Fraud Prevention Header Lint for Making Tax Digital
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the Gov-Client and Gov-Vendor header mistakes HMRC rejects, in your editor, offline, before you send the request.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → HMRC Fraud Prevention Header Lint for Making Tax Digital: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 34 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/hmrc-fraud-prevention-header-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/hmrc-fraud-prevention-header-lint
